pages.text: The core machine of Akaishi tech: burning Akaishi materials generates Chi Energy, which purifies Raw Akaishi Blocks into Akaishi Essence.
Crafting the purifier requires a Red Machine Component, a Furnace, a Blast Furnace, Gold Ingots and Raw Akaishi Blocks.

$(bold)Fuel:$(br)$(li)Akaishi Crystal$(li)Raw Akaishi Block$(br)$(bold)Purifying:$(br)Draws 5 Chi Energy per tick to turn Raw Akaishi Blocks into Akaishi Essence.$(br)Connect it to an Energy Cell via pipes so it never runs dry.
